steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Siv! The detector's showing one more person up ahead!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Think you can hang in there?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Huff... Huff... I'm fine, let's go...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: This place is way too remote, and wasn't in the area covered by the infrared detector...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I applied to advance the range one kilometer this way, and discovered a survivor nearby, but haven't pinpointed the precise location yet. Hurry, hurry...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: This town is clearly within the local Catastrophe Messenger's detection range, so how did this happen?!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: An earthquake of this magnitude should've had obvious signs. There's no way anyone stationed here could've missed it.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: It's already been four and a half days. I'm starting to think it might be...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Besides, Rhodes Island was just passing by, and we're not at all prepared for this level of rescue operation.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Don't talk like that!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Let's go. There's still hope.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Here, right here! They should be under the rubble. Hurry up, Siv!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: This is the rescue team! Do you hear me? We're from the rescue team, we're here to help you!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Can you hear me? Please answer!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: No response. Siv, try tapping a steel pipe!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Got it.
Tap tap tap, tap tap tap...
Tap tap tap, tap tap tap...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Any response?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: None... And we weren't assigned a life-detector. Is there a better way of confirming the exact location? There were survivors before who just didn't have the strength to respond. Maybe I should apply for a—

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Ugh... It'll be too late by then. Plus, there's no guarantee they even have any to spare. We'll do this the old-fashioned way. Listen carefully—even the scratching of fingernails makes a sound.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I'll try tapping the pipes over there. Or do you have any Originium Arts that can help locate them?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Haha... If I did, then I wouldn't be digging through rubble with my bare hands...
Tap tap tap, tap tap tap...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: I've knocked on this entire area and didn't get any responses.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: It's been so long, and this place is so remote. Were we... too late again?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: No... there's still another place up ahead. I'll go over and take a look.
Tap tap tap, tap tap tap...
*Scratch*... *Scratch*...
*Scratch*... *Scratch*...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I hear it! It's the sound of nails on pipe!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Here, over here! Hurry, Siv!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: I'm coming! ...Gah! Hiss...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Careful! Take a break if you can't handle it anymore!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: I'm fine, I can keep going. We've got a life to save!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Can you hear me? We're from the rescue team, we're here to help you!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Here, let's move this board out of the way. Careful not to hurt yourself. Three, two, one!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Hnngh!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: We should still have some saline solution left, so let's pass it down with a hose.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: There's saline water on the way! Drink up, and we'll begin the rescue!

steps.name: Old Granny
steps.text: *cough*... *cough*...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: It's an elderly person?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Granny?

steps.name: Old Granny
steps.text: Ugh... I thought... nobody would come...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: No way! We're here for you!

steps.name: Old Granny
steps.text: Thank goodness...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: I've already started scanning the structure with radar. Hold on just a little longer!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Granny? Granny?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: She's losing consciousness! We can't let her fall asleep here!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: I'll handle the scan. Head over and keep her awake!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Granny, Granny? Don't go to sleep just yet, let's have a little chat first!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: It's dangerous to fall asleep right now. Wake up, and we'll talk, okay?

steps.name: Old Granny
steps.text: How many days has it been...?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: ...Um, two! Two days! We were nearby and came as soon as we could! Everything will be okay!

steps.name: Old Granny
steps.text: Ngh...

steps.name: Old Granny
steps.text: My grandson... Have you seen my grandson?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: (Have you seen him? Any young kids?)

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: (No, I haven't...)

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Granny, we're divided into teams who are all responsible for different areas. Maybe another team has already taken him to safety. We'll have a look after we get you out of here!

steps.name: Old Granny
steps.text: My grandson... is a little troublemaker...

steps.name: Old Granny
steps.text: I don't know where he's run off to...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Don't you worry, I'm sure he's just fine!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: (Looks like they also raised fowlbeasts here. The coop has collapsed, and there's nothing left.)

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Granny, your grandson must've been real lucky. Is that a fowlbeast coop I see over there? I love me some fowlbeast eggs!

steps.name: Old Granny
steps.text: Is that so... Oh my... little fowlbeasts... golden and shiny...

steps.name: Old Granny
steps.text: The eggs... are probably crushed now...

steps.name: Old Granny
steps.text: If there are any left... you can try some...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Don't worry, it'll be fine! I'm sure we can have some later!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: You're the 30th person we've rescued today. We just dug through an entire house somewhere else, and rescued a whole family...

steps.name: Old Granny
steps.text: Mm... Mm...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: (Is the scan done yet?)

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: (Here you go.)

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: (Is the sinking severe?)

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: (...It's messy.)

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: (The sinking's already begun over here, but the other side of the house hasn't collapsed. Probably a different soil layer. The terrain here is... complex. The seismic waves were reflected by its shape as they passed through.)

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: (The whole house is twisted, and if this side is demolished, the other will lose its support and collapse. It's not an option.)

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: (Do we seriously have to dismantle and clear out the other side first, just to ensure stability?)

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: (Do we have time for that...?)

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: (Not a chance in hell. It's too big of a job for just the two of us anyway.)

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: (We'll have to talk the old lady through it first, but... if we clear out what we can and think on our feet, there might still be a way.)

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Huff... Huff... Ugh...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Ever seen a Lupo before, Granny?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: We'll remove the stuff on top first, clean up a little, and get you out of there!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Then you'll get to see a purple Lupo with the biggest, bushiest tail there is!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: You know it! Once you're out, you can pat my tail! I bet you've never seen one as big as mine!

steps.name: Old Granny
steps.text: Mm... Mm...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Hurry up, she can't hold out much longer.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Don't fall asleep just yet! You know, my grandma is about the same age as you... And I want to try some of those eggs too!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: I've already cleared all the rubble that can be safely removed. Next I'll try propping up this beam. You think it'll be stable enough?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Three, two, one... Hup!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: No good! It's already starting to loosen!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Let's try over here then!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: I'll hold up the middle. Head over and chip off that half while I support the other half!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Alright, just tell me when you're reaching your limits.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Don't panic, Granny, we'll... we'll definitely to save you!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: One more time! I'm going to knock down this section!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Nngh! So... just you wait! We'll go find your grandson once you're safe!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Keep it steady!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: We've already cleared one of the beams, Granny! Hang in there!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Hang in there, hang in there... The beam over here, once it's cleared...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Granny?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Don't fall asleep!

steps.name: Old Granny
steps.text: I can't...

steps.name: Old Granny
steps.text: Two days is... a pretty long time...

steps.name: Old Granny
steps.text: Don't... worry about me...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: No, don't say that! Keep going, Provence!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Can you still hear her breathing underneath? She hasn't responded for a while now...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: It's been too long. Let's stop.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: She's probably already...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: No, no! No!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Logistics Operator
steps.text: Provence squad? Survivors have been found near point 28, 575. Please hurry.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: ...We've received new coordinates. 1673, 589. One victim, about 2.7 meters deep. Heavy equipment is needed to dismantle the rubble.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: We'll head straight there... Mhm, I'm fine.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I'm sorry, I'm so sorry. We're... We're going to rescue someone else.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Let's go, Siv. We've got someone else to save. The team responsible for finding the casualties will come around later.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Are you okay...?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Aaaaaaaaargh!!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Aaaaaagh!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Stop it! You're not good at—

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Aaaaaaaaargh!!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: I'm going to dig her out!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: *gasp*... *gasp*...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Urgh...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Stop, Siv! You're only destroying your own health, and it's not helping anyone! There are still so many more people to save!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: No! I have to—

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Aaaaaagh!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I told you, stop!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: What more do you want?! Are you going to sacrifice yourself here? Nothing we do will change the situation! Don't sacrifice yourself for someone who's already dead!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: We still have others to save! And until we do, your own life takes priority!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: We need to go, now! We can't afford to fall behind!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: The team searching for casualties will be here soon. We'll ask where the old lady ended up later, okay? There's someone else waiting for us.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Someone once told me that to save more people, you must first protect your own life.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: No matter what happens, you must always value your own life... All lives are equally important, including your own.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: So let's go. Together.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Over here! Found another one over here!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Hang in there a bit longer! Hold onto my hand, we'll have you out soon!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Alright, you're safe now!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Your family? Don't worry, see that tent up front? All our personnel should be over there, so go take a look!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: If you have any questions, you can talk to any of the operators there and they'll be glad to help you!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Don’t you worry!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: It's okay, calm down. I assure you, you won't have to pay for the treatment.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Yes, yes, I guarantee it. Just sit over there and don't go running off again.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: No need to be nervous. You'll be fine.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I'm too tired to even speak.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Same.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: It's quiet here... Brush away the rocks and come lie down.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Ugh... Ow ow ow, my waist... Ah...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: How many... did we manage to save today...?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Dunno... I feel like I can't move a muscle...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: But I still find it so weird...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: What's weird?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I've been thinking... We're in Victoria, right? This place is pretty remote, but the town's not exactly small, and there was supposed to be a Catastrophe Messenger here.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Uh huh...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: So how did all this happen? No Catastrophe Messenger could've failed to detect a Catastrophe of this scale, even if it wasn't obvious.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: No idea... Maybe they skimped on the disaster avoidance procedures...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: No way... What happened here wasn't just poorly done. It's more like... there were no efforts at all.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Everyone was basically trapped in their homes. No way they'd be indoors if they knew a Catastrophe was coming.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Maybe some kind of fringe belief about accepting Catastrophes...? None of it makes any sense.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Maybe they just didn't believe what their Catastrophe Messenger had to say... That happens too, doesn't it?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Yeah, it happens... and I've been there myself. But a whole town? Never.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Ugh... So many dead...
...How could I... not know... who...
...Right now... they...
...Why... you... should have...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: There are still people over there? I'll ask them to come rest with us.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: (They're not with Rhodes Island?)

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: (Townsfolk?)

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: (Not sure. Doesn't seem like it? The locals should all be recovering in the tents. What are they doing all the way out here?)

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: (Should we sneak a peek?)

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: We already got the money. What now?

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Bloody hell! You're the one who said to put on a show and make it convincing! Who the hell would care if a Catastrophe Messenger wasn't at the site of the disaster? 'Struggled to evacuate everyone but couldn't make it in time' my ass, now I'm all covered in soot!

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Look at what happened! The box is buried under the house. Where's the money now, huh? Under a pile of bloody rubble, that's where! You gonna go dig it up?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Was it really okay to cause this big of a scene?

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: The hell are you talking about? Now's the best time for us to bounce! Everything's a bloody mess outside, so hurry up and dig out the money so we can leave by tonight!

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: Change our names, leave the country. This money should last for a while, and with so many bloody Catastrophes everywhere, there'll never be a shortage of ways to make more.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Fine...

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: So stop dilly-dallying and dig it up already! I'm covered head-to-toe in dust, and you expect me to do it?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: (Those bastards...!)

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: (It's not that the townspeople didn't believe it, they weren't even warned!)

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: (They... got all those people killed!)

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: (Wait, cool your jets!)

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Hold it right there!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Who the hell are you?!

steps.name: Catastrophe Messenger
steps.text: That uniform... From that rescue organization...?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: It doesn't matter who I am, but you're not getting out of here!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Dereliction of duty! And you call yourself a Catastrophe Messenger?!

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Think this kid overheard us? We can't have him spilling the beans!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Provence squad here. Is this the landship? Requesting field op support at 683, 447.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Our goal is just to detain them... Don't go overboard.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Provence, we finished our investigation...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: What's wrong? You don't look so good.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Logistics Operator
steps.text: So, you're already aware of what happened.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Logistics Operator
steps.text: Here's the rub: the Catastrophe Messenger DID report this... to the nobles. If that's true, the only error is that many people who should've been taking refuge died instead.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Logistics Operator
steps.text: But as you know, nobles... don't exactly care about human lives, as long as there are enough left to collect taxes from.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Logistics Operator
steps.text: And these two scumbags are on the nobles' side. If they grease the right palms, they might even be spared from legal action.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Logistics Operator
steps.text: We're leaving the day after tomorrow, first thing in the morning. We only stopped here for the rescue operation, and we don't have the luxury of getting involved in some drawn-out court case.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: ...So you're saying that's it? We should just give up, because there's a chance we might not get the outcome we want?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Logistics Operator
steps.text: No... That's not what I'm saying.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Logistics Operator
steps.text: Why do you have to make me feel like the bad guy here?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: I REALLY don't want hear that from you.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: There was no need for any of those people to lose their lives. Not a single one should've died! I, I...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Suing them is one thing, but I've seen their victims with my own eyes... Those people who should not have died...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: If we just walk away, how are we supposed to make those bastards pay for this? For all the lives they snatched away?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Logistics Operator
steps.text: I get where you're coming from... But we'll still be bringing a case against them.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Logistics Operator
steps.text: We've already prepared the documents, but there's no telling what the result might be. And we can't afford to wait either, just for the sake of intervening in a process that we're far from sure will produce a favorable outcome.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: So you're telling us to not get our hopes up...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: I suppose I've been naive about this from the start.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: What's the point of even filing it then? Forget the death penalty, they'll probably get away with a small payment and a slap on the wrist. It'll mean nothing to them, and make us look like fools.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Damn it all! All those people, dying for nothing!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Logistics Operator
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Logistics Operator
steps.text: I know it's a bitter pill to swallow.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Let's not overthink this and focus on what we CAN do.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Let me see those documents. We're leaving the morning after, right?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Logistics Operator
steps.text: Around 10 AM.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I won't be leaving with you then.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Logistics Operator
steps.text: What will you do...?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Only what I should do... What I can do.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Excuse me, sir, are you the judge here? I'm Provence, Rhodes Island Operator—

steps.name: Local Judge A
steps.text: —Don't bother me!

steps.name: Local Judge A
steps.text: Can't you see we're busy with repairs here?!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I know, but it's really important and—

steps.name: Local Judge A
steps.text: I told you not to bother me!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Hello, is anyone here? I'm Provence, Rhodes Island Operator.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Hello?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Nobody's in, huh...
She left. Don't open the door for strangers at times like these! You never know what kind of misfortune you might invite!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Thank you so much for letting me in. These are Rhodes Island's documents regarding the Catastrophe. We wanted to file an action against the Catastrophe Messenger Whelan...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Ah!

steps.name: Local Judge B
steps.text: File for legal action? With me? Matters concerning Catastrophe Messengers should be brought to the High Court, and it's up to their discretion whether to...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I know, I know, but can you hear me out first? Just take a look at these documents, please!

steps.name: Local Judge B
steps.text: ...I suppose I can do that.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: So there's the situation. We're holding two of them at Rhodes Island for now, but we don't have the right to detain them indefinitely. Besides, we're leaving the day after tomorrow.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: If this is turned over to the High Court, the nobles might just refuse to even hear it. This is brought up in the documents as well—the case may well be left without a conclusion.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Exploiting Catastrophes to make money, trampling over peoples' lives, knowing the horrors to come yet deliberately not informing people—only truly vile people would do these things!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: To him this was simply a way to make money. If he cannot be punished under the law, in a situation we can control, who knows how many more murders he will go on to commit?

steps.name: Local Judge B
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Local Judge B
steps.text: But... even if I do file the case at the local level, once it's submitted up the chain, it may inevitably end up...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I'll inform the townspeople! I'll get in touch with the locals, and even people from neighboring towns! I'll take care of all that!

steps.name: Local Judge B
steps.text: Fine...

steps.name: Local Judge B
steps.text: Alright, I'll see what I can do. Given the situation... I can apply for a higher court to accept the case after about half a month.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Thank you so much, Mr. Tal! I'll go hand the culprits over to a security guard. Please, send me a Messenger as soon as you get a follow-up!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Here's the temporary shelter for the townspeople we rescued...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Sorry for bothering you, everyone, but I have an announcement to make!

steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Townsfolk B
steps.text: Oh, it's the purple lass! She rescued me with one of her buddies!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I am a Catastrophe Messenger and one of the Rhodes Island operators involved in the rescue operation. The earthquake was indeed a Catastrophe, but the local Catastrophe Messenger failed to inform you!

steps.name: Townsfolk B
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Instead, he took advantage of it—and your very lives—to make money. Yesterday, he was going to flee with the cash in hand!

steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: Where is he now?!

steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: We'll kill the bastard!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Judge Tal will be reviewing the case, but the nobles may let it go unresolved in order to help the two criminals escape the reach of the law. Therefore, I would like to ask this of all of you—

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Can we work together to keep the nobles from interfering in this case?

steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: Alright! You saved my life, lassie. Whatever you say, we're behind you!

steps.name: Townsfolk B
steps.text: But how is that even possible...? How can we get the nobles to listen to us?

steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: Lass! Do you think we'll have enough people?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: What if I recruited people from other towns too?

steps.name: Townsfolk B
steps.text: Maybe... but even that might not be enough to persuade the nobles!

steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: Yeah. When have they ever lifted a finger for us?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I... I'll do whatever I can!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: This is the center of town.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Hello? Excuse me, I'm from the next town over...

steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: What? I'm busy right now, so scram!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: The neighboring town was just hit by a Catastrophe...

steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: Catastrophes, huh? Yeah, we get plenty around here too! Lost half the town to one. Thought we'd never seen one before?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I know! And they can be avoided, but because of the Catastrophe Messenger—

steps.name: Townsfolk A
steps.text: Whatever, I've heard enough. I told you, I don't have time for this!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Excuse me, the neighboring town suffered a terrible tragedy because their Catastrophe Messenger hid the truth from them. We hope you can support us in preventing the nobles from interfering with the case...

steps.name: Townsfolk B
steps.text: Is that supposed to be a joke? Where's the punchline?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: No, I'm serious! We're planning to escalate the case, so if you're—

steps.name: Townsfolk B
steps.text: You wish.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Yes, so that's what happened... Please, are you able to help us? We really need all the help we can get...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Thank you so much! Here's my contact information; I'll be reaching out in about half a month!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Thank you so much!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Hello, I was wondering...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Sorry to bother you, but...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Thank you so much! I'll be contacting you in about half a month!
Four months later...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Messenger
steps.text: Provence! There's a letter for you!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Coming!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I wonder who'd be writing me...

a.text:
Good day. r
r
This is Tal, the judge from the town you helped out before. It is with great excitement that I write this letter to you, and I hope it reaches you soon.

Through our efforts, Whelan and his accomplice have been sentenced to death. They are to be executed in the rebuilt town square tomorrow morning, as of this writing. The blood money they applied for was used in the post-Catastrophe reconstruction, and things have been gradually improving.

Also, the townspeople asked me to pass on their greetings. They are truly appreciative for everything you've done, and we wish the best for you and Rhodes Island. Bless you, and stay safe. r
r
Tal

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Take a look at this.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Remember that town that suffered an earthquake? They sent a letter.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: They did it... They...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: They really did it?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Yeah... They really did it.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Really? They got the sentence?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: I never thought... I didn't think it was possible, but you...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Stop bawling your eyes out already. Here, a handkerchief.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: *sob*... Ugh, th-thank you...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: Is this the reason you were away from the landship for so long, Provence?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: More or less. It wasn't quick, that's for sure...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: I never knew... I, I've been wallowing in misery, but you...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: I'm such a letdown.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Don't say that. Practically speaking, we couldn't really intervene in what happened afterwards.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: But call this my own selfishness. I just couldn't leave things hanging like that.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: And even if we did manage to secure some kind of justice... It's still too late for those who already suffered in the Catastrophe.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Ugh, but that's enough of that! Let's pay a visit to that Granny's grave some time.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator
steps.text: I'd like to put some yellow rocks in front of her resting place... to remind her of all those little fowlbeasts she raised...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Mhm, let's do that then. I'm sure she'd be happy.
